svg.title: BoxLite Sandbox: your agent's commands run in a local micro-VM
svg.desc: The model calls Coder, Shell or FileSystem tools such as run_command and edit_file. BoxLiteSandbox's get_workspace hook gives the run a BoxLite micro-VM on your own machine as ctx.workspace. The BoxLite runtime runs inside your process, and each command and file operation runs in the VM, which has its own kernel and filesystem; output comes back to the tool. The first use boots the box, its WorkspaceRef is saved in the message history and on the result, a later run reattaches with it, and destroy(ref) deletes it. A new box has no network; with allow_internet_access=True and allowed_hosts it can reach only the listed hosts.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
